positions.name: RollbackRehearsalMandate
positions.frame: what does it mean for a rollback capability to actually exist?
positions.why: The source declaration ties the reality of a rollback capability to its rehearsal, and the commentary's cadence/owner fields read as the operational cashing-out of that same claim — same directional read: rehearsed-and-owned is what makes the rollback real, not merely documented.
